evidence: Carries the Wallet label and modifies sendall RPC option validation in src/wallet/rpc/spend.cpp.
rationale: Strictly validating sendall options prevents severe unintended actions like spending all wallet UTXOs when 'inputs' is misspelled or broadcasting transactions when 'add_to_wallet' or 'psbt' is mistyped. Silently ignoring invalid options presents a clear fund-safety hazard for wallet callers.
